name: garna_attacker_dies_draws
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever another creature you control dies, draw a card if it was attacking. Otherwise, Garna deals 1 damage to each opponent.' Seat 0's Bear attacks alone (Garna stays home) and Opp Giant (4/4) blocks and kills it: the Bear died attacking, judged by its last known information (CR 603.10a, 608.2h), so seat 0 draws a card and seat 1 takes nothing. Engine wave E1 made IS_ATTACKING read LastKnown.attacking and a bare Conditional judge it on 'it' (before, every death dealt the damage). The other branch: garna_a_creature_that_was_not_attacking_dies_deals_one.json.
